EV Battery Health Intelligence¶

Technical documentation for the EV Battery Health Intelligence project. The project turns vehicle telemetry, vehicle master data, and charging-session CSVs into one health record per vehicle, then exposes the result through Amazon S3, Athena, and QuickSight.
